selection.selection_mix: 70% highest TVL, remaining capacity highest current APY

panel.entry_exit_treatment: Observed pool-specific dates only; no synthetic backfill

episode.censoring: Episodes active at each pool's last observation are right-censored

ranking.summary_aggregation: Pooled mean across valid observed-date x top-k comparisons; each valid comparison receives equal weight

event_study.trigger: 1-day APY increase >= 5 percentage points and APY >= 10%

joint_screen.definition: Pool is above the sample medians for APY, persistence and TVL

figures.title: Yield universe: APY comparisons need category and capacity context
figures.question: What is the observed stablecoin yield universe?
figures.message: The sample covers multiple pool types and chains, so APY should not be compared without stratification.

figures.title: Headline APY is heavy-tailed, so medians matter
figures.question: How are APY observations distributed?
figures.message: A small number of extreme APY observations pulls the mean above the median.

figures.title: Most high-yield episodes fade quickly in the observed sample
figures.question: How long do APY >= 10 percent episodes last?
figures.message: Kaplan-Meier survival declines steeply at short durations, with censored active episodes retained.

figures.title: Top-yield membership changes as the horizon widens
figures.question: How stable are top-yield rankings?
figures.message: Heatmap cells show separate top-k means; pooled text summaries weight each valid observed-date/top-k comparison equally.

figures.title: Joint screen shows the trade-off behind headline APY
figures.question: Which pools combine APY, persistence and TVL?
figures.message: Only a subset sits above median APY, persistence and TVL simultaneously; this is a joint threshold screen, not a recommendation.

figures.title: Base and reward APY describe different yield mechanisms
figures.question: How much of APY comes from base versus reward components?
figures.message: Reward coverage is partial and reward-heavy pools should be interpreted separately.

figures.title: After APY jumps, yield and TVL move on different clocks
figures.question: Are APY jumps followed by TVL changes and compression?
figures.message: Event-time patterns are observational and use TVL change only as a proxy.

figures.title: Peg stress changes the denominator behind nominal yield
figures.question: How do APY and price behave around stablecoin peg stress?
figures.message: A depeg window makes nominal APY harder to interpret without price context.

figures.title: Pool archetypes separate yield level, persistence and capacity
figures.question: Do pools cluster into interpretable profiles?
figures.message: Exploratory clusters summarize patterns but are not labels of safety or quality.

figures.title: High yield is common; persistent high yield with capacity is rarer
figures.question: Which pools combine APY, persistence and TVL?
figures.message: Only a subset sits above median APY, persistence and TVL simultaneously; this is a joint threshold screen, not a recommendation.

sources.role: Pool universe, APY components, TVL and history
sources.evidence: 15,669 live pools observed; 250 selected for full analysis
404 assets and 2,012 price date records verified

sources.endpoint: Aave, Compound, Curve, Yearn, Sky/Maker, Ethena and selected docs
sources.evidence: Classification is metadata, not a safety rating
